title: Whitley Strieber's traumatic abduction, which he calls a communion

tellings.quote: take Whitley Strieber as an example who said he was raped anally and to this day decades later he puts ointment on to uh cover the uh wounds he experienced but at the end of the day he says it was a communion.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic experiences, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the writer Whitley Strieber, who says he was abducted and anally raped by the beings that took him. According to Mishlove, Strieber still puts ointment on the wounds decades later, yet he calls the whole experience a communion. Mishlove offers it to show how an encounter can be both terrible and, to the person, deeply meaningful.
